visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a living room with a woman featuring short, curly brown hair wearing a black floral shirt. She gestures emphatically with her right hand while speaking. A younger woman with long, green-streaked hair appears, holding a smartphone displaying the time 11:49. The room is brightly lit with warm indoor lighting. (2) The younger woman sits on a beige sofa, holding a large bowl of white rice topped with meat. She uses chopsticks to eat while animated food graphics (dumplings, noodles) float around her. The camera uses fast cuts to show her eating small portions repeatedly. (3) The background shifts to a bright studio setting with light-colored curtains. The younger woman, now in a red off-the-shoulder top, holds a red and gold Clarins Double Serum bottle. She applies the liquid to her cheeks and forehead using her fingers. (4) Close-up shots focus on the product's twisting cap mechanism and the smaller eye serum bottle. Split-screen comparisons show the woman's face with and without the product, highlighting skin luminosity and tightness around the eye area. (5) The woman stands in the studio holding both Clarins products, smiling at the camera and touching her face to demonstrate smoothness. The lighting is high-key studio lighting with a soft, clean aesthetic.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: One elderly woman with short curly brown hair and a floral shirt. One younger woman with long hair featuring prominent green streaks, wearing a red top.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A home living room with a beige sofa and framed wall art, transitioning to a clean studio background with white and sheer gold curtains.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A loud, exaggerated female voice shouts in a mix of Mandarin and Hokkien, creating a high-energy comedic tone. Fast-paced electronic pop music with a strong rhythmic beat plays in the background. A sharp 'ding' SFX sounds as a phone screen appears. (2) Multiple 'pop' and 'cartoon bounce' sound effects accompany the rapid eating montage. The narrator's voice maintains a high arousal level with frequent upward pitch inflections. (3) A distinct 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the shift to the product review. The background music continues but becomes slightly lower in volume. The narrator's tone shifts to a smoother, professional broadcast quality. (4) Shimmering 'sparkle' SFX are triggered when the skincare products are highlighted on screen. Mechanical 'click' sounds correspond with the twisting of the bottle cap. (5) The music reaches a crescendo with more percussive hits during the comparison reveal shots, concluding with a warm, friendly vocal sign-off and a sharp cut to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comedy Skit -> Problem Identification -> Product Introduction -> Feature Demonstration -> Result Comparison -> Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Clarins skincare products by using a relatable comedic skit about Chinese New Year family interactions, positioning the serums as the secret to maintaining a youthful appearance and 'winning' against nosy relatives.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features direct product demonstrations, naming the brand 'Clarins' multiple times, and listing specific ingredients and benefits of the Double Serum and Eye Serum.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly effective blend of localized social comedy and high-end beauty marketing. The fast editing and high audio event density cater to short-form mobile consumption habits.
